scope: native pre-focus capture, display-removal recovery, transcript finalization, and stale iframe admission

commands.assertions: Messages from a replaced parent reference are rejected, while exact-parent origin and size fences remain enforced.
Native activation captures prior-window context before focus and keeps the companion reachable after display removal without replacing the renderer.

commands.command: pnpm exec vitest run src/features/chat/VoiceComposerButton.test.tsx src/features/chat/ChatWorkspace.test.tsx src/features/companion/CompanionPresentation.test.tsx; pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
commands.assertions: Repeated equivalent final transcript callbacks are ignored; active tasks can be stopped with Enter; denied capture leaves text chat enabled; Portal UI types compile.

assertions: Activation capture is completed before native focus and late capture cannot override a manual presentation decision.
A removed display causes the native window to be repositioned onto the available display while preserving the renderer and state.
Equivalent final transcript events cannot create duplicate downstream submissions, while a later utterance remains accepted.
A delayed message from a closed/replaced iframe parent is rejected by exact parent identity admission.
The active task Stop control receives focus and Enter cancels the task.
A denied native capture reports unavailable context while preserving an enabled text composer.
limitations: Live Windows/macOS display and focus evidence remains unavailable in this environment.
The transcript test exercises the composer callback boundary; a live Audio Tools duplicate-event trace is still pending.
